unavailable.purchase: no purchases in a run, sandbox included (user rule)
unavailable.low-balance: the shared test account holds ~20,000 credits and the Android debug controls have no balance override
unavailable.new-account: needs an account with no AI Mini Drama creations; the test account has many
unavailable.chat-count: the Developer Server daily chat limit is 9999 and the app shows no remaining count
unavailable.voice: speech-to-text needs spoken input, which Appium cannot give the phone
unavailable.full-generation: user 2026-10-21 (REQ-019): asked not to run this many full generations; template journeys stay Blocked
unavailable.stt-failure: observability: no fault switch makes speech-to-text fail; ask RD for a fixture (observability)
unavailable.slow-generation: observability: no fault switch keeps a character generation running for 5 minutes; ask RD for a delay fixture
unavailable.remote-config: test-data: changing the Firebase Remote Config daily chat allowance needs RD; the Developer Server limit is 9999
unavailable.paid-tier: test-data: Android 16.8 has no debug tier switch; needs a test account with a Pro subscription (ask the user)
unavailable.permission-reset: test-data: resetting PowerDirector's media permission is an Android system setting; ask the user before the run
unavailable.tablet: test-data: the run phone (Xperia 10 III) is not a tablet
unavailable.app-language: test-data: switching the app language needs an Android system setting (Settings › Apps › PowerDirector › Language); ask the user before the run
unavailable.fault-injection: observability: Android 16.8 has no fault switches (iOS Pink); ask RD for a fixture or a debug build
